links.comparator_used: Unassisted gastroenterologists interpreting endocytoscopic BE images without AI assistance (AI offered as an optional second assessor)
links.outcome: Sensitivity and accuracy for identifying dysplasia in Barrett's oesophagus at follow-up
links.effect: AI-assisted gastroenterologists outperformed unassisted ones: sensitivity +20.0% (p = 0.025) and accuracy +12.22% (p = 0.05); they maintained high sensitivity and accuracy at follow-up
links.quote: Contrastingly, AI-assisted gastroenterologists maintained high sensitivity and accuracy at follow-up, subsequently outperforming the unassisted gastroenterologists (+20.0%, p = 0.025 and +12.22%, p = 0.05).
